title: Six systems beneath one learner, and where the six failures sit
subtitle: No single screen caused the tickets. The failures are in the hand-shakes between systems.
note: 2 marks a failure point, 1 marks a system that acts at that stage without one. The largest ticket class is the top left cell, raised before the learner had ever logged in.
source: The as-is ecosystem blueprint in section 5 of this case study.
